Biplabendu Das, known as Billu, obtained his Ph.D. in bioinformatics, following which he did postdoctoral research at Stanford University.
Billu works as a Data Scientist / Data Engineer for two nationwide, longitudinal studies aimed at understanding brain & cognitive development in adolescents (ABCD Study) & newborn babies (HBCD Study).

We turn research data into tools people use every day, built in R.
We build:

websites, for scheduling visits or keeping an eye on your data
interactive dashboards, to explore and analyze your data flexibly
applications, for gathering and analyzing data in real time
automated data pipelines, from collecting data to visualizing patterns

We also offer:

statistical analyses, to find patterns in data and plan interventions
data visualization, to make complex patterns easy to see
data workshops, with hands-on training in analysis and visualization
